identification: 1933 Australian florin (George V, Melbourne) in Fine to VF, and a 1942 Melbourne (no mintmark) threepence, VF. Both in labelled card holders. Florin is a scarcer date but not rare; threepence is a common-ish minor coin.

viewing_check: Check the florin date is really 1933 (clear 3s), look for cleaning, scratches or rim damage, and check the true grade (Fine vs VF). Check the threepence has no mintmark and the date is 1942 (not 1942 D or S). Ask whether coins can be removed from holders.
